name: Interactive SVG Animations
summary: Self-paced interactive course teaching SVG syntax and how to animate SVGs, from basics to SMIL, paths and filters.
description: An interactive course on SVGs and SVG animation by Nanda Syahrasyad. Five chapters with 39 interactive lessons and 13 exercises cover SVG syntax, CSS and SMIL animation, the path element, gradients, masks and filters.
contains: chapters: Foundations, Your First Animation, Animating the Unanimatable, Paths, Advanced SVG Details
